      ProcedureOutputable ProcedureOutputMgmt.createProcedureOutput(ProcedureOutputable procedureOutput, Long procedureId)
      Creates a procedure output by traversing all the data in the passed procedureOutput The method calls ProcedureOutputMgmt.getOutputFieldClassNames() and ProcedureOutputMgmt.getOuputFieldMapForClass(String) to traverse the data by class and then encodes each field using that field's ProcedureOutputField metadata.
